notes.title: v1.01 Update - massively improved XBox controller support
notes.content:
XBox controller support has been massively improved. Your rocket will turn and face the direction of the left stick and A is used to thrust. It's very different to the previous controller setup but much easier to use. See under Controls in the game for full details.

Menus and dialog boxes now work with mouse, keyboard and controller.

Also some minor bug fixes and quality of life improvements have been made.
